body_markdown:
Ford gave us our first look at the upcoming Bronco RTR way back in January of this year. That’s when it let us know about the RTR’s unique 2.3-liter four-cylinder engine with anti-lag technology and its cooling system parts that it pirated from the Bronco Raptor. Starting with 33-inch tires and its own suspension tuning developed with RTR founders Vaughn Gittin, Jr. and Loren Healy, the RTR can also be equipped with the Sasquatch package and its HOSS 3.0 suspension system with Fox internal bypass shocks and 35-inch tires. It carves out a niche for itself by providing ample trail capability along with full-throttle fun in the sand.


[In its latest release](https://www.fromtheroad.ford.com/us/en/home) , Ford has provided a few more details on this RTR, including its base price, which will start at just over $50,000. For customers who want the ultimate Bronco RTR and opt for the RTR graphics package, the Hyper Lime appearance package, and the Sasquatch package with its upgraded suspension and bumpers, the price will come in under $60,000 before destination.

The Hyper Lime package will likely be popular, as the RTR’s signature accent color is splashed throughout the interior. “For the cabin, we took the functional design and usability customers expect in a Bronco and paired it with the vibrant touches that differentiate the Bronco RTR exterior to make sure that every commute reminds you of weekends off the map,” said Kellie Walters, Bronco Color and Materials Designer. “And we did that by extending RTR’s signature Hyper Lime to specific parts of the cabin in ways that feel intentional and alive. You see it in the unique seatbelts, in the stitching, in the grab handles, and in the instrument panel accents. Those elements are more than pops of color. They create rhythm and identity throughout the interior and give the vehicle a sense of attitude the moment you climb in.”


The 2027 Bronco RTR is the first trim in the Bronco lineup to be covered in the “Everything You Need to Know” series on[Ford From The Road](https://www.fromtheroad.ford.com/us/en/home) . The other big news in the Bronco lineup,[the Filson Edition](https://www.hagerty.com/media/news/bronco-filson-edition-will-push-fords-4x4-upmarket/) , will likely be the next in the pipeline.
